description: This source file defines a class `PlayerInfoImplementation` that implements the `Exchange::IPlayerProperties` interface for managing media player properties such as codecs and resolution, utilizing GStreamer libraries for media capabilities detection. It includes utility classes for GStreamer registry and caps handling, and has some support for Dolby integration.
